setup.title: Set up — {repo}
setup.meta: Set up the {repo} Flatpak remote and start installing signed apps in one command — per-user or system-wide, with Flathub for runtimes.
setup.heading: Set up {repo}
setup.intro: {repo} is a signed Flatpak remote. Add it once, then install any app from the catalog — with the CLI or the Install button. The whole remote is signed with a single GPG key.
setup.scope.question: Per-user or system-wide?
setup.scope.user.desc: — installs just for you, no admin needed.
setup.scope.system.desc: — installs for everyone, asks for admin.
setup.scope.note: Keep both commands on the same tab — don't mix scopes. The commands update to match.
setup.step.add_remote.title: Add the {repo} remote
setup.step.add_remote.body: Registers the signed {repo} repository. You only do this once.
setup.step.add_flathub.title: Add Flathub for runtimes
setup.step.add_flathub.body: {repo} apps build on the freedesktop runtime hosted on Flathub. Skip if you already have it.
setup.step.install.title: Install an app
setup.step.install.body: Or just press Install on any app page — it opens your software installer.
